bullets: Safe wallet keycards can now recover funds on many more blockchains, including EVM chains, Solana-style, XLM, Tezos, ICP, HBAR and ALGO. XLM and HBAR recovery also supports external signers.
Zama confidential tokens are live on mainnet: shield and unshield now work in production, ZAMA can be picked for staking on Ethereum wallets, and wrap and unwrap fixes shipped for multisig wallets.
New asset support: ZAR Universal on ARC and XRP, and Grass on Solana for Go Accounts. Zcash wallets are also prepared for the NU7 upgrade expected around 5 Nov 2026.
Stellar transaction explanations now show every account-settings change before signing and flag unmodeled operations. Stellar tokens with digits in their names, like USDM1, now work for withdrawals.
Staking and trading expand: Stacks staking supports configured PoX-5 contracts, and the Canton SDK supports Broadridge delegation, allocation requests and settlement authorization.

features.oneLiner: Adds support for ZAR Universal on ARC and XRP, plus the Teuroc test token on Sepolia, with matching trading-account equivalents.
features.whyItMatters: Client-requested tokens can now be recognized by wallets, pricing and the UI. Clients can hold and use ZAR Universal on two more networks.

features.whyItMatters: Customers holding Safe wallets can recover funds across many more chains. Offline recovery avoids auto-broadcasting transactions, and recovery fails safely if the provided keys don't match the wallet.

features.whyItMatters: Newly onboarded tokens become recognized across BitGo wallets and trading accounts. The exact token list isn't stated, so check the individual changes for details.

features.title: Fuller XLM transaction explanations before signing
features.oneLiner: Stellar transaction explanations now show every account-settings change, such as signers, thresholds and home domain. They also flag operations the tool doesn't model.
features.whyItMatters: Reviewers, for example in the offline vault console, can see everything a transaction does before signing. This lowers the risk of approving hidden changes.

signals.title: feat(sdk-coin-xlm): report full setOptions fields and unmodelled ops in explain

features.title: Zcash shielded transactions accept randomizer-only input
features.oneLiner: Zcash shielded partially-signed transactions can now be built with a randomizer that supplies only the 'rk' value. The input gives no further detail.
features.whyItMatters: This likely widens Zcash shielded transaction support. The purpose is not described in the input, so treat this reading as tentative.

signals.title: feat(zec): accept rk only randomizer for shielded psbt

features.title: Fix crash approving message-signing requests
features.oneLiner: Approving a message-signing request no longer crashes the SDK; the message is now left to be signed separately as intended.
features.whyItMatters: Developers who approve message-sign or typed-data-sign requests through the SDK hit an error before this fix. Approvals for these requests now complete reliably, so message-signing workflows can proceed.

signals.title: fix(sdk-core): skip auto-sign for message-sign approvals
fix(sdk-coin-starknet): remove dead Sepolia RPC dependency from unit test

features.title: Fix Stellar token withdrawals with digits in name
features.oneLiner: Stellar tokens whose asset codes contain numbers, such as USDM1, are now accepted, so unsigned withdrawal transactions can be explained and processed in OVC.
features.whyItMatters: A client could not withdraw xlm:USDM1 from its Go account because the transaction failed validation in OVC. This unblocks withdrawals for Stellar tokens with alphanumeric codes.

signals.title: fix(sdk-coin-xlm): accept alphanumeric Stellar asset codes in StellarToken

features.title: Node.js 22 support deprecated in SDK
features.oneLiner: The SDK documentation now says Node.js 22 is deprecated ahead of its April 2027 end-of-life. Nothing is removed yet.
features.whyItMatters: Customer developers running the SDK on Node.js 22 get advance notice to plan an upgrade. Removal is tracked as a later follow-up.

signals.title: docs(root): deprecate Node.js 22 support

features.title: Zcash Ironwood spend support
features.oneLiner: Adds building, inspecting and verifying Zcash Ironwood spend transactions, including keyless construction, TypeScript access and refreshed anchor and witness data on spends.
features.whyItMatters: This lays the groundwork for spending Zcash Ironwood funds through BitGo's SDK tooling. The input gives little customer-level detail, so scope and availability need confirming.

feat(wasm-utxo): derive Ironwood bundle flags from real spends and outputs

feat(wasm-utxo): verify Ironwood bundles without viewing keys

features.title: Fix ERC-7984 wrap approval rebuild verification
features.oneLiner: Fixes a failure where the server-side approval of a confidential-token wrap (ERC-7984) on onchain multisig wallets was rejected during verification.
features.whyItMatters: Pending approvals for wrapping confidential tokens could not be completed on onchain multisig wallets. The fix lets those approvals verify and go through.

signals.title: fix(abstract-eth): ERC-7984 PA-rebuild approval verifies content-based

features.title: Mainnet Zama confidential token shield/unshield enabled
features.oneLiner: Registers the on-chain details for six mainnet Zama confidential token pairs (ERC-7984) so wrap, approve and unwrap (shield/unshield) can work on production.
features.whyItMatters: Until now, shield and unshield requests on mainnet failed because the token pairs weren't registered. This is the SDK prerequisite for supporting Zama confidential tokens in production.

signals.title: feat(statics): wire mainnet ERC-7984 wrapper-underlying metadata for Zama tokens (CHALO-2007)

features.title: Fix token setup for non-Ethereum EVM chains
features.oneLiner: Corrects how about 95 tokens on OKB X Layer, Base, and Flow are configured, so they use the right token type.
features.whyItMatters: Tokens set up with the wrong type could behave incorrectly or break the SDK when stricter checks are added. This keeps token support on these chains reliable for customers and their developers.

signals.title: fix(statics): use erc20Token for non-ETH EVM entries in botTokens

features.title: Support for Node.js 26 in SDK
features.oneLiner: The BitGo SDK now works on Node.js 26, including a fix for Cardano message signing that broke on that version.
features.whyItMatters: Customers' developers can run the SDK on the newest Node.js version. Without the Cardano fix, message encoding on Node.js 26 would have been silently cut short and failed to decode.

signals.title: fix(sdk-coin-ada): stop using cbor's sync encode statics for CIP8 structures
feat(root): support Node.js 26 and test Node.js 27

features.title: Shielded Zcash transactions for MPC wallets
features.oneLiner: Adds keyless building and parsing of shielded Zcash transactions for MPC Zcash wallets. The PR gives no further detail.
features.whyItMatters: This likely extends shielded Zcash support to MPC wallets. The source is a title only, so the exact customer impact is unclear.

signals.title: feat(zec): keyless shielded build and parse for MPC zec wallets

features.title: Unified addresses on Zcash transparent outputs
features.oneLiner: Zcash version 6 partially signed transactions now accept unified addresses on their transparent outputs.
features.whyItMatters: This likely lets customers send to Zcash unified addresses in more transaction types. The source is a title only, so confidence is low.

signals.title: feat(zec): allow UA on transparent outputs of v6 psbt

features.title: Read spent inputs from Zcash v6 transactions
features.oneLiner: Adds a lower-level function to list the previous outputs a transaction spends. Version 6 Zcash transactions now behave like version 4 when pending approvals are…
features.whyItMatters: Pending-approval creation for version 6 Zcash transactions works consistently with older versions. This is mostly internal plumbing, and customers would only notice it as reliability.

signals.title: CSHLD-2087: Route PA-creation input ids through wasm for v6 PSBTs

features.title: Spend-rule checks for descriptor wallet signing
features.oneLiner: Descriptor wallets now check the policy's spend rules (timing, sequence, preimage, single lockup input) before the SDK signs a PoX-5 exit.
features.whyItMatters: Hot descriptor wallets previously signed PoX-5 exits without these checks. Adding them makes sure invalid exits are blocked before signing, which matches the protection the offline vault already has.

signals.title: fix(abstract-utxo): check the descriptor policy spend rules when a descriptor wallet signs

features.title: Zcash transaction checks for encrypted data and change
features.oneLiner: Adds verification of the encrypted cipher data and change output on Zcash transactions. Details are limited in the source.
features.whyItMatters: Stronger checks on Zcash transactions help confirm funds go where intended, including change returning to the wallet. Exact scope is unclear from the input.

signals.title: feat(zec): verify enc cipher and change output

features.title: Fix Go Account naming for Solana OpenUSD
features.oneLiner: Corrects the Go Account naming used for the OpenUSD token on Solana.
features.whyItMatters: Accurate account naming keeps OpenUSD on Solana displaying and behaving consistently for Go Account users. Details are limited in the source.

signals.title: fix(sol): updated go account naming for openusd

features.title: Fix ERC-7984 wrap/unwrap on custodial multisig wallets
features.oneLiner: Fixes wrap, unwrap and finalize-unwrap for ERC-7984 tokens on Ethereum-family multisig wallets, including approving them as pending approvals and building them through the API.
features.whyItMatters: These operations previously failed with missing-parameter or schema errors. Customers using ERC-7984 confidential tokens can now complete wrap and unwrap flows, including approval of pending requests.

signals.title: fix(sdk-core): send empty recipients for ERC-7984 builds (CHALO-1957)

features.title: Pass attestation through withdrawals and MPC signing
features.oneLiner: The SDK and Express now accept an optional attestation on withdrawal and threshold-signing requests and pass it along to BitGo. They do not verify it.
features.whyItMatters: Developers can attach attestation data to withdrawals and signing requests. This is groundwork for services that need it. The purpose of the attestation is not stated in the source.

signals.title: WCN-1565: Pass attestation through MPC signing

features.title: Transaction size calculation for Zcash v6
features.oneLiner: The underlying library can now return the unsigned Zcash v6 transaction so its size can be calculated, instead of failing.
features.whyItMatters: It lets the wallet platform check fees on pending approvals using the real transaction size rather than an approximation. This is internal plumbing with no direct customer interface.

signals.title: CSHLD-2073: Support v6 transaction size calculation in wasm-utxo

features.title: ZAMA staking available for Ethereum wallets
features.oneLiner: ZAMA now appears in the Stake asset picker for Ethereum wallets in production, so customers can select it for staking.
features.whyItMatters: Mainnet ZAMA was filtered out of the Stake picker even though backend staking support existed. Customers with the staking flag enabled can now start ZAMA staking from the UI.

signals.title: feat(statics): enable staking feature for mainnet eth:zama (SI-2153)

features.title: Canton custodial timing data kept in transactions
features.oneLiner: The SDK now preserves custodial ledger-time metadata when serializing Canton transactions for broadcast.
features.whyItMatters: Keeping timing metadata intact helps Canton custodial transactions broadcast correctly. The input gives limited detail, so the exact customer impact is unclear.

signals.title: feat(sdk-coin-canton): serialize custodial ledger-time metadata in broadcast transactions

features.title: Fix wallet share acceptance failure for some users
features.oneLiner: Bulk accepting wallet shares no longer looks up the sharing key when it isn't needed, fixing an error for users without one.
features.whyItMatters: Users with no sharing key on file, such as those accepting Go Account or OFC rotation shares, hit a confusing 'encryptedXprv not found' error. They can now accept these shares.

signals.title: fix(sdk-core): skip ECDH keychain lookup in bulkAcceptShare when unneeded (WCN-3735)

features.title: Stacks staking supports configured PoX-5 contracts
features.oneLiner: The Stacks SDK can now build and accept transactions for a configured PoX-5 staking contract, including the test and dummy contracts, with safeguards.
features.whyItMatters: Registering for Stacks PoX-5 bonding was blocked because the contract wasn't the canonical one. Custody and offline vault signing and wallet platform flows can now handle it. Allowances are set in the SDK, are pair-specific and expire.

signals.title: feat(sdk-coin-stx): accept a configured PoX-5 staking contract pair (pair-scoped + expiring)
feat(sdk-coin-stx): allow a caller-supplied staking contract (SI-2106)

features.title: Corrected Canton test token contract addresses
features.oneLiner: Contract addresses for 499 Canton test tokens were updated to match the official token export.
features.whyItMatters: Accurate contract addresses help Canton test tokens resolve and transact correctly. Only the address format changed; no tokens were added and non-Canton tokens were untouched.

signals.title: fix(statics): correct canton token contract addresses

features.title: Canton support for Broadridge delegation and settlement
features.oneLiner: The Canton SDK now supports Broadridge standing delegation, allocation requests and settlement authorization transactions, including reading the responses.
features.whyItMatters: Clients using Canton with Broadridge can set up standing delegations and authorize settlements through BitGo. This extends Canton support to Broadridge's settlement workflows.

signals.title: feat(sdk-coin-canton): support Broadridge standing delegation intent
feat(sdk-coin-canton): Support Broadridge standing delegation response parsing
feat(sdk-coin-canton): support Broadridge allocation and settlement authorization flows

features.whyItMatters: The fix addressed an error after approval and re-sign of message-signing requests. Since it was reverted, the issue may still be open. The reason for the revert isn't stated.

features.whyItMatters: Keeps the internal beta release process running reliably. No customer-visible change.

signals.title: fix: skip unpublished beta-tools dist tags

features.whyItMatters: Keeps the service on a supported, patched runtime. Customers who self-host should note the updated Node prerequisite in the README.

fix(docker): upgrade node runtime to 22.23.4

features.title: Express Docker image moves to Node 24
features.oneLiner: The BitGo Express Docker image now runs on Node 24 instead of Node 22, matching the version used in the project's own configuration.
features.whyItMatters: Customers who self-host the image get a newer runtime. The PR flags this as a major-version change that could affect native modules, so self-hosting customers should test before upgrading.

signals.title: feat(express): run Express image on Node 24.22.1

features.title: Express no longer hangs on failed sends
features.oneLiner: Fixes a bug where BitGo Express never replied when a send failed partway, leaving clients with a 503 timeout. Errors now return properly.
features.whyItMatters: Developers now get a clear error when a send fails, rather than a hanging request and timeout. This makes failed sends easier to diagnose and handle.

signals.title: fix(express): handle circular request bodies in error redaction

features.title: XLM and HBAR recovery supports external signers
features.oneLiner: Stellar (XLM) and Hedera (HBAR) wallet recovery now uses a shared external signer, and a backup key is optional when one is supplied.
features.whyItMatters: Customers can sign recovery transactions with their own external signing setup instead of handing over a backup key. A safeguard also stops signed data from being altered after signing.

signals.title: feat: migrate recover to ExternalEd25519Signer

features.title: UTXO library: checked randomizer and signing path
features.oneLiner: Internal update to the UTXO WASM library that consolidates randomizer handling and spend-signature creation into one checked path. The PR gives no further detail.
features.whyItMatters: The purpose is unclear from the input. It looks like groundwork for shielded-transaction support, but that is not confirmed, so it isn't clearly customer-visible.

signals.title: feat(wasm-utxo): single checked randomizer and spend-signature path

features.title: UTXO library: KMS ciphertext and proof helpers
features.oneLiner: Adds helper functions to the UTXO WASM library for KMS output ciphertext and proofs. The PR gives no further detail.
features.whyItMatters: The purpose is unclear from the input. It appears to be developer-level groundwork rather than a change customers would see directly.

signals.title: feat(wasm-utxo): KMS out_ciphertext and proof helpers

features.title: Grass (Solana) token support for Go Accounts
features.oneLiner: Adds the Grass token on Solana to Go Accounts so incoming Grass deposits can be credited to the customer's account.
features.whyItMatters: Before this, Grass deposits arrived as unmatched deposits and couldn't be credited to Go Accounts. Customers can now hold and use Grass there. Rollout still needs a statics publish and a Prime release.

signals.title: CSHLD-1989: feat(statics): add go-account support for sol:grass

features.title: Zcash NU7 network upgrade support
features.oneLiner: Prepares Zcash wallets and recovery for the NU7 network upgrade, expected around 5 Nov 2026, using the correct transaction format after activation.
features.whyItMatters: Without this, Zcash transactions and recoveries made after the upgrade could be signed but fail to broadcast. It keeps ZEC transfers and recovery working through the network change.

signals.title: CSHLD-2024: Update wasm-utxo and zcash recovery defaults for NU7
CSHLD-2013: Add NU7 mainnet support

features.title: Generic parsed-input types for UTXO library
features.oneLiner: Adds shared internal data types for reading transaction inputs, including Zcash-specific ones, in the UTXO library. The PR gives no more detail.
features.whyItMatters: This looks like developer-facing groundwork for Zcash and UTXO handling. The input has no description, so the customer impact is unclear.

signals.title: feat(wasm-utxo): generic parsed-input type and Zcash parsed types

features.title: Solana v1 transactions now honored in payments
features.oneLiner: When developers request a Solana v1 transaction version, the SDK now passes it through. Before, it was silently dropped and v0 was used.
features.whyItMatters: Developers asking for Solana v1 payments previously got v0 transactions with no error or warning. Now the requested version is respected.

signals.title: feat(sdk-core): forward SOL intent wire version (Refs: CHALO-1603)

features.title: Fix token test for cross-chain address reuse
features.oneLiner: Corrects an internal test that wrongly rejected the same token contract address on different blockchains.
features.whyItMatters: This is a test-only change, so customers see no effect. It stops false failures when the same token address legitimately appears on more than one chain.

signals.title: CECHO-2510: statics: ERC20 duplicate-contract-address test rejects legitimate cross-chain address reuse

features.title: Pass Hardhat config secrets as environment variables
features.oneLiner: Internal fix so all secrets used by the Ethereum multisig contract tooling configuration are supplied as environment variables.
features.whyItMatters: Internal build and deployment tooling change. No direct customer impact is described.

signals.title: fix: passing all the secrets accessed by hardhat config as env variables

features.title: Fix TIA withdrawals to memo-tagged recipients
features.oneLiner: Withdrawals of TIA (Celestia) to recipients with a memo no longer fail local validation with a false outputs-mismatch error.
features.whyItMatters: Memo-tagged addresses are common for exchange deposits. Before the fix, these TIA withdrawals were wrongly rejected, even though the built transaction was correct. Customers can now send them.

signals.title: fix(sdk-coin-tia): normalize memo-suffixed recipients in verifyTransaction

features.title: Solana confidential transfer token enablement
features.oneLiner: Token enablement in the SDK now supports Solana confidential transfers. It can create the token account and configure it for confidential transfers in one transaction.
features.whyItMatters: Customers' developers can enable Solana tokens for confidential transfers with a single transaction. It also fixes an instruction layout issue in the account configuration step and adds an opt-out flag.

signals.title: feat(sdk-coin-sol): confidential transfer token enablement (CHALO-1883)

features.title: EdDSA MPCv2 signing in Advanced Wallets
features.oneLiner: Master Express now supports signing for EdDSA wallets on the newer MPCv2 protocol. It automatically routes to the right flow based on wallet version.
features.whyItMatters: EdDSA MPCv2 wallets can sign transactions through the external signer setup. Existing MPCv1 EdDSA wallets and ECDSA wallets continue to work as before.

signals.title: feat: add eddsa mpcv2 signing orchestration and routing

features.title: Change safe MPC child key derivation encoding
features.oneLiner: The path used to derive safe child keys for MPC wallets is now encoded as UTF-8 text bytes. Key creation and offline recovery both use…
features.whyItMatters: Every party must use the same encoding, or the derived child keys differ. This keeps key creation and offline recovery consistent. Teams should check compatibility with any previously derived keys.

signals.title: fix: derive safe MPC child at UTF-8 path bytes
